context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 16 testing completed successfully. Key features verified: 1) Daily Updates module at /dashboard/daily-updates with 5 update types (progress, material, payment, installation, om) - all CRUD operations working. 2) Payments API (POST/GET /api/payments) working and integrated with Customer Credit report. 3) Material Usage API (POST/GET /api/material-usage) working with variance calculation and integrated with Excess Utilisation report. 4) Data Completeness API (/api/projects/{id}/completeness) returns score 0-100 with 6 checks: customer_details (20%), site_data (20%), electrical_data (15%), costing (20%), site_docs (10%), daily_updates (15%). 5) Project Report API (/api/projects/{id}/report) returns full project data with payments, material_usage, daily_updates, total_paid, balance, payment_status. 6) 4 new report types added: customer_credit (payment status distribution), referral (lead sources with revenue), team_load (staff workload with Overloaded/Balanced/Underutilized), excess_utilisation (material variance). 7) All 20 report types now have chart_data for pie chart visualization. 8) Enhanced filters on Reports page include Customer and Staff search inputs.
